# Matias Medina — Frontend Engineer

> Personal portfolio of Matias Medina, a Frontend Engineer with 5+ years of experience building scalable React and Next.js applications. Based in Santiago, Chile; available for remote work with US/Canada teams. English C1, Spanish native.

Currently at FloQast (via FullStack Labs), working on a micro-frontend architecture for 3,000+ Enterprise clients including Zoom and Snowflake. Previously led the frontend team at Kandui.cl, a FinTech startup. H-1B1 visa eligible, full EST/PST timezone overlap.
